record.name: Warleader
record.description: Warleaders are masters of leading defensive operations and inspiring troops. They excel at coordinating protective strategies, motivating defenders, and using their leadership abilities to ensure victory through superior defensive tactics.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Master defenders who inspire their allies to protect and serve.

progression_tree.description: You can use your bonus action to grant yourself a temporary hit point equal to your level. This hit point lasts for 1 minute and is not lost if you fall unconscious.
You can use your action to grant one of your allies a bonus to their Armor Class equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1). This bonus lasts for 1 minute.
You can use your bonus action to grant all allies within 30 feet of you a bonus to their initiative equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1). This bonus lasts for 1 minute.
You can use your action to grant one of your allies a bonus to their attack and damage rolls equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1). This bonus lasts for 1 minute.
You can use your bonus action to grant all allies within 30 feet of you a bonus to their attack and damage rolls equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1). This bonus lasts for 1 minute.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: The Warleader assumes a powerful stance, feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent, radiating an aura of confidence and authority as they prepare for battle.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A soft blue glow emanates from the Warleader's body, pulsing with a gentle yet intense power that seems to harmonize with their surroundings and inspire those around them to defend the innocent.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Generate an image of a wise and courageous guardian Warleader standing tall in combat, surrounded by their loyal allies, radiating wisdom, strength, and protection.
contextual_modifiers: Include the Warleader's noble steed, a majestic creature with a coat as white as snow and mane that shimmers like gold in the sunlight.
Depict the battle-scarred terrain of the planet they are defending, with twisted trees and rocks providing cover for their allies as they prepare to face the enemy hordes.
